modality: presencial — Canal Universitats (Generalitat de Catalunya) lists the delivery mode verbatim as "Face-to-face"; centre is Campus de la Comunicació Poblenou, Edifici Tànger, C. de Tànger 122-140, 08018 Barcelona
language_of_instruction: English. The Generalitat de Catalunya's official Canal Universitats programme entry is titled verbatim "M.Sc. in Sound and Music Computing (taught in English)" and its language field reads "English". This is a government register page, directly fetched, NOT the university's own (blocked) page and NOT a translated version of a Spanish page.
language_requirement: NOT FOUND — no explicit English certificate level (B2/C1/IELTS/TOEFL) could be confirmed; the SMC admission page is on www.upf.edu and returns 403 to every automated fetch.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2025-26 (the last year for which UPF's own non-EU credit price is confirmed). The 2026-27 and 2027-28 non-EU credit prices are NOT PUBLISHED / not confirmable — see notes.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — large, and it is the decisive cost fact for this programme. Catalonia's Decret 96/2026 (DOGC 9689, 18.6.2026) art. 1.5 does NOT fix a non-EU price; it authorises each university's consell social to set it: «Els consells socials de les universitats públiques ... poden establir el preu dels crèdits en qualsevol nivell d'estudis per als i les estudiants estrangers no residents que no siguin nacionals d'estats membres de la Unió Europea ni dels estats en els quals sigui aplicable el règim comunitari, sense que el preu corresponent pugui excedir el 100% del seu cost». The same article states that a Spanish long-stay study authorisation does not confer residence: «l'autorització d'estada de llarga durada per estudis, mobilitat d'estudiants, serveis de voluntariat o activitats formatives concedida als i les estudiants estrangers no equival a la condició de residents» — so this candidate cannot escape the surcharge by moving to Barcelona. UPF's own tariff page (www.upf.edu/web/masters/preus) states that for students from outside the EU the Consell Social approves the credit price annually and that for 2025-2026 it is 93,5 EUR per credit, versus the decree's 19,37 EUR/credit for EU/resident students in a non-habilitante master — a multiplier of roughly 4.8x. 93,50 x 60 = 5,610 EUR for the 60-ECTS master alone.
entry_requirements: An official undergraduate degree/diploma (bachelor's degree, degree in engineering or architecture, diplomas, technical engineering and technical architecture diplomas — or, for foreign qualifications, the equivalent qualification awarded by an accredited higher education institution), plus the academic transcript of the accredited official training with the average grade at the university of origin. Selection: "the excellence in the academic CV as related to the topics of the master is the most important aspect that is considered in the admission process"; the Motivation Letter is the second important element. 25 places offered (Canal Universitats).
accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT — the stated admission requirement names "a degree in engineering" among the accepted qualifications, and the title sits in the RUCT rama "Ingeniería y Arquitectura", campo "Ingeniería informática y de sistemas". A Software Engineering degree is squarely in scope.
complementary_credits_required: TWO DIFFERENT ANSWERS, BOTH REAL, AND THE DISTINCTION MATTERS. (a) TITLE LEVEL: 0 (RUCT) — the register records Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos = 0, i.e. the verified title carries no compulsory bridging credits, and the 60 ECTS break down as 35 obligatorios + 5 optativos + 20 TFM. (b) APPLICANT LEVEL: UPF states on the SMC pages that students take the 60 ECTS "plus up to 50 credits of complementary credits from advanced undergraduate courses (extending the program to two years)", that "depending on the previous education and specific interests, the student might be required to take extra credits and extend the duration of the Master to two years", and that "the specific courses to take are decided between the tutor and the student in accordance with the student background and specialization desired". So complementos here are an individual admission/tutorial decision, not a title requirement — exactly the case the brief warns about. A conflicting figure of "up to 15" complementary credits also appears in the indexed UPF text (see conflicts). NEITHER page could be opened directly: www.upf.edu returns 403 to all automated fetching.
credit_recognition_available: NOT ESTABLISHED, and this is the single most important open question for this programme. The candidate's 300-ECTS 5-year Software Engineering degree is precisely the profile that ought to make complementos unnecessary — 300 ECTS exceeds the 240-ECTS bar by a full year — but no UPF page could be read that says a longer prior degree exempts the applicant, and no reconocimiento-de-créditos rule for this master could be confirmed. UPF does operate a general master's credit-recognition procedure ("Credit recognition — Master's Academic Secretary", https://www.upf.edu/en/web/secretaria-master/reconeixement-de-credits-academics), also 403-blocked. Financially the stakes are: 60 ECTS x 93,50 = 5,610 EUR if no complementos are imposed, versus up to 110 credits over two years if the maximum 50 are imposed. Whether complementary credits are charged at the same non-EU 93,50 EUR/credit rate is NOT stated anywhere reachable; if they are, the maximum case is 110 x 93,50 = 10,285 EUR plus a second year of living costs. A HUMAN MUST ASK THE SMC ADMISSIONS OFFICE DIRECTLY, in writing, before this programme can be costed.
application_window_2027: NOT PUBLISHED for the September 2027 (curso 2027-28) intake. For the 2026-27 cycle UPF opened applications on 14 November and ran FOUR rounds with deadlines 14 January / 4 March / 27 April / 5 June 2026. These are 2026-27 dates and are recorded as such; they are NOT shifted forward a year here. If the pattern holds, a 2027-28 cycle would open in November 2026 with a first deadline in mid-January 2027, but that is an expectation, not a published fact.
application_rounds: 2026-27 cycle (NOT 2027-28): applications opened 14 November; round deadlines 14 January 2026, 4 March 2026, 27 April 2026, 5 June 2026
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES — EXPLICIT. UPF states: "International candidates are encouraged to apply in the first and second application periods to allow admitted candidates enough time to address visa issues and get their documents legalized." For a Tunisian applicant this means targeting the first (mid-January) deadline.
admissions_contact_email: NOT FOUND — the SMC contact page is on the 403-blocked www.upf.edu domain.
curriculum_summary: 60 ECTS. RUCT breakdown: 35 ECTS obligatorios + 5 ECTS optativos + 20 ECTS Trabajo Fin de Máster, 0 ECTS prácticas externas. Named courses surfaced include Advanced Computing Techniques for Sound and Music and Music Recording and Mixing. The 20-ECTS Research Project involves "carrying out a research project and writing a thesis report under the supervision of a teacher", with a weekly class to present and discuss the individual thesis work. NOTE: the Generalitat Canal Universitats entry publishes a DIFFERENT breakdown (25 obligatorias + 15 optativas + 20 TFM) — logged as a conflict.

language_of_instruction: "Castellano" — stated verbatim as the idioma de impartición on the Universidad de Oviedo's own programme page. HARD LANGUAGE FILTER: a two-year, 120-ECTS quantitative master taught entirely in Spanish is not realistically accessible to a candidate at A0/A1 now, even reaching B1-B2 by September 2027.
language_requirement: NOT FOUND — no certificate level published. The binding constraint is Castellano teaching.
tuition_year_of_rates: As published on the Universidad de Oviedo programme page on 2026-08-25. The page prints the rate table without an explicit academic year; the 21,84 €/crédito first-enrolment figure matches the Asturias Decreto de Precios Públicos 2026-2027 (nivel de experimentalidad II, 1ª matrícula), so the table is read as 2026-27. FLAGGED as an inference from the matching figure.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — explicit and quantified on the university's own programme page, which publishes two separate columns: Spanish/EU citizens and eligible nationalities pay 21,84 €/crédito on first enrolment (45,10 on second, 88,16 on third and subsequent), while NON-EU STUDENTS pay 45,10 €/crédito on every enrolment including the first. That is the second-enrolment rate applied from the outset — the same penalty-tier mechanism Madrid uses, and a 106% uplift. Legal basis: the Asturias Decreto de Precios Públicos 2026-2027 art. 1.2 authorises the university to differentiate the credit price for non-resident foreigners over 18 excluding EU nationals, up to 100% of cost («el precio de la matrícula podrá cubrir hasta el 100% de los costes»); the decree does not fix the figure, so the university's own published tariff is the operative source — which is exactly what is used here.
entry_requirements: Optimal entry profile: degrees with substantial coursework in mathematics, accounting, finance, economics, business administration, commerce, marketing, ENGINEERING or similar. Universidad de Oviedo grados named as preferred: Matemáticas, Contabilidad y Finanzas, Economía, ADE, Comercio y Marketing. 20 places. General master access rules at https://cei.uniovi.es/postgrado/masteres/accesoyadmision; applicants from non-EHEA systems must supply a certificate that the degree gives access to master's study in the awarding country.
accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT BUT SECONDARY — "engineering" appears in the optimal-profile list, but every named preferred degree is a mathematics/economics/business grado from Oviedo itself. This is a quantitative-business master whose default intake is economists and mathematicians, not software engineers. A Software Engineering graduate is admissible; the ECONOMÍA complemento (below) is the likely consequence.
complementary_credits_required: ★ THE ONLY PROGRAMME IN THIS BATCH WITH A QUANTIFIED, NAMED APPLICANT-LEVEL COMPLEMENTOS SCHEME. The programme publishes two 4,5-ECTS foundation modules for students lacking adequate preparation: MATEMÁTICAS (4,5 ECTS) and ECONOMÍA (4,5 ECTS) — i.e. up to 9 ECTS in total. For this candidate the Matemáticas module is very unlikely to be required (a 300-ECTS software engineering degree carries far more mathematics than 4,5 ECTS), but the ECONOMÍA module is a realistic imposition, since his background contains no economics at all. Register position: output/ruct-detail.jsonl records ects_complementos_formativos as null for 4315881 — NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT — while a wave-1 note reported 4,5 ECTS complementos declared in the register. The RUCT detail page returned HTTP 503 on re-fetch here so the discrepancy could not be resolved; both readings are logged as a conflict. The programme page's 4,5 + 4,5 scheme is the figure to rely on because it is the applicant-level rule and it was directly fetched.
credit_recognition_available: MECHANISM EXISTS, NO ENTITLEMENT PUBLISHED. The programme page points to Universidad de Oviedo's postgraduate regulations at http://cei.uniovi.es/postgrado/masteres/normativa for reconocimiento de créditos, but no rule addresses a 300-ECTS prior degree and no quantity is promised. The practical question for this candidate is narrower and more answerable: can a 300-ECTS engineering transcript WAIVE the 4,5-ECTS Matemáticas complemento (almost certainly yes) and the Economía one (probably not)? That should be put to the coordinators directly.
application_window_2027: NOT PUBLISHED for the September 2027 (curso 2027-28) intake. For curso 2026-2027 the Universidad de Oviedo published a periodo extraordinario with preinscripción «Del 3 al 31 de agosto de 2026», provisional lists 04/09/2026, reclamaciones 07-09/09/2026, listas definitivas 11/09/2026, matrícula 14-16/09/2026. application_rounds: curso 2026-27 (NOT 2027-28) periodo extraordinario: preinscripción 3–31 August 2026; listas provisionales 4 September 2026; reclamaciones 7–9 September 2026; listas definitivas 11 September 2026; matrícula 14–16 September 2026
non_eu_early_round_advised: NOT STATED as a rule, but applicants from non-EHEA systems must first obtain a certificate that their degree gives access to master's study in the awarding country, and Ministry grade-equivalence certification where a grade comparison is needed — both slow. An extraordinary period closing on 31 August with enrolment in mid-September leaves no visa runway at all, so the ordinary period is the only realistic route for a Tunisian applicant.
